name: pulsar_events
description: Notable backend events (failures, refusals, fallbacks, LLM provider outcomes), by event name and LLM provider.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="pulsar-backend" AND jsonPayload.message=("query_rejected_off_topic" OR "ambiguity_check" OR "web_fallback" OR "web_fallback_failed" OR "web_fallback_unexpected_error" OR "inspire_search_failed" OR "query_rewrite_failed" OR "search_failed_unexpectedly" OR "request_failed" OR "deferred_enrichment_failed" OR "llm_provider_succeeded" OR "llm_provider_failed" OR "llm_provider_skipped" OR "llm_all_providers_failed")
